evidence.text: Can logarithmic quantum corrections to string-inspired running-vacuum cosmology help alleviate the Hubble and structure-growth tensions, and under what assumptions can graviton corrections dominate matter corrections in the modern approximately de Sitter era?

sources.title: Dark Energy and String Theory

evidence.text: Relate dual and ordinary spacetime volumes to obtain an intensive action, then vary that action. For the cosmic-brane models, connect its numerator to axion-dilaton anisotropy and its denominator to transverse area; an alternative argument uses codimension-two logarithmic Green functions and dimensional transmutation.

sources.title: Stringy running vacuum model and current tensions in cosmology

evidence.text: Background equations are expanded to first order in the small running parameter. Synchronous-gauge linear perturbations are treated iteratively and implemented with the background equations in a modified CLASS Einstein–Boltzmann solver.

sources.title: String-inspired running-vacuum cosmology, quantum corrections and the current cosmological tensions

evidence.text: Review estimates of chiral-GW anomaly condensates and one-loop integration of graviton fluctuations around approximately de Sitter backgrounds. Compare with renormalized matter-field calculations, then represent dominant graviton corrections by an effective R ln(R/R₀) action; detailed cosmological fits are delegated to earlier work.

sources.title: Dark energy from string theory: an introductory review

evidence.text: Single-field exponential quintessence is studied using dynamical systems: fixed points, their stability and late-time attractors organize cosmological histories and asymptotic behavior.

sources.title: Saltatory relaxation of the cosmological constant

evidence.text: Reduce to four-dimensional Einstein frame and canonically normalize form-field kinetic terms to infer physical charge densities. Wrapped-brane tensions follow cycle volumes, whereas charge scaling requires the moduli-space metric, examined near degeneration.

sources.title: Dark Energy and String Theory

evidence.text: Expand the doubled noncommutative effective action in the fundamental length parameter λ, integrate over dual coordinates, and identify ordinary gravitational and vacuum-energy terms. At zeroth order the displayed action separates ordinary and dual curvature contributions.

sources.title: Dark energy: EFTs and supergravity

evidence.text: Can string-inspired EFTs and supergravity generate naturally light dark energy, alleviate the coincidence problem, and support viable quintessence or de Sitter solutions within calculational control?

sources.title: Asymptotic scalar field cosmology in string theory

evidence.text: Which inequalities relate the exponential decay rates of the Hubble scale and the lightest particle tower along dynamically accessible infinite-distance limits, and what would these imply for late-time string cosmology?

sources.title: String Cosmology: A Review

evidence.text: How does string theory's ultraviolet structure inform spacelike singularities, inflationary model building, moduli dynamics and dark energy, and which resulting cosmological signals could constrain particular constructions?

sources.title: On de Sitter Spacetime and String Theory

evidence.text: Can string theory accommodate asymptotically de Sitter spacetime with a small, radiatively stable positive cosmological constant, a holographic description, and realistic visible and dark sectors? The review argues that answering this requires examining formulations beyond conventional gravitational EFT.

sources.title: Dark Dimension With (Little) Strings Attached

evidence.text: Can worldsheet consistency in weakly coupled string theory relate dark energy to a light tower's mass gap, and which phenomenological scenarios survive observational constraints without additional fine-tuning?

sources.title: String Cosmology

evidence.text: These lectures review how string theory might accommodate a small cosmological constant and inflation, emphasizing moduli stabilization, obstacles to flat inflaton potentials, possible remedies, and observational signatures.

sources.title: Challenges for superstring cosmology

evidence.text: Can the paper's 1992 'current superstring lore' support inflation and lead cosmologically to a vacuum with zero or small cosmological constant and time-independent Newton constant?

evidence.text: How can a string model produce late-time dynamical dark energy while retaining volume stabilization during inflation, a viable quintessence mass and couplings, and a large hierarchy between Hinf and H0?

evidence.text: Can a large ensemble of string solutions yield useful distributions of particle-physics properties or a statistical account of a small cosmological constant?

sources.title: A two-dimensional string cosmology

evidence.text: Four-point correlators are decomposed into intermediate Liouville momenta and Virasoro blocks. Zamolodchikov recursion generates truncated elliptic-nome expansions; crossing symmetry reduces the moduli integral to a finite domain.

sources.title: A two-dimensional string cosmology

evidence.text: The three-punctured sphere reduces to a product of Liouville three-point coefficients. The four-punctured sphere requires integrating the product of the two Liouville four-point functions over its complex modulus.

sources.title: A two-dimensional string cosmology

evidence.text: For numerical integration with the modulus integrated first, channel counterterms subtract regulator-induced power divergences. A small disk around z=0 is treated analytically with a next-to-leading-order block expansion; its exterior is integrated numerically.
